title: UX flow and interaction design

any: a screen, flow, component, or interaction state changes
responsive or accessibility behavior is undecided

skill_calls.when: a user flow or UI state changes
reusable component, token, layout, or interaction rules change

nodes.obligation: Define flow, state coverage, responsive behavior, and reusable design implications.

tests.evidence: loading, empty, error, partial, disabled, and success states are dispositioned
tests.command_source: design sources and target UI test inventory

workline_policy: Split only when design decisions need independent ownership, approval, or artifacts before implementation.
omission_rule: NOT_APPLICABLE for changes with no visible flow, component, state, responsive, or interaction effect.
repair: Unresolved flow or state behavior reopens design-flow.
Reusable-rule gaps route to design-system before dependent frontend readiness.
